sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def charbox(L):
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(8,45) for c in range(15,54) if L[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    p=[(r,c) for (r,c) in p if not (r>=36 and c<=27)]
    if not p: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in p];cs=[x[1] for x in p]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def trydir(d):
    b=charbox(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'))
    action([d])
    a=charbox(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'))
    moved = b!=a
    print(f"{d}: {b} -> {a} moved={moved} changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')} lvl={last_action_result.get('level_completed')} done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    return moved
print("start:", charbox(current_frame.ascii.split('\n')))
# test RIGHT and DOWN (the previously blocked ones) from new position
trydir('RIGHT')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
